# Konstatines Consulting Services Limited

> Construction, land and equipment operations in Sierra Leone; geospatial analysis — data analytics, GIS mapping and real estate intelligence — delivered remotely across Africa.

Konstatines Consulting Services Limited is a Freetown-based firm with field operations in Sierra Leone and remote consulting work across the African continent. Site content is written in English with an optional Krio (KRI) translation layer; English is authoritative. Country reference material was last reviewed September 2026. Contact: kt@krent.sl.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sierraleonebuild.com/): Services overview — construction, land and equipment in Sierra Leone, plus geospatial analysis delivered remotely across Africa.
- [Sierra Leone — Country Profile](https://sierraleonebuild.com/knowledge/sierra-leone): A fourteen-article reference on the land, climate, people, economy and the laws governing ownership and investment in Sierra Leone.

## Services — delivered across Africa

- [Geospatial Analysis](https://sierraleonebuild.com/#works): Data analytics, cartography, GIS mapping and real estate intelligence — turning location, market and spatial datasets into clear, decision-ready insight for investors and developers.

## Services — delivered in Sierra Leone

- [Land Selection](https://sierraleonebuild.com/#works): Independent site verification, title due diligence and structured acquisition support.
- [Selection of Materials](https://sierraleonebuild.com/#works): Sourcing, specification and procurement of structural, finishing and specialty materials from vetted suppliers.
- [Earthmoving](https://sierraleonebuild.com/#works): Bulk excavation, grading, trenching and full site preparation using heavy plant and experienced operators.
- [Concrete & Reinforcement](https://sierraleonebuild.com/#works): Reinforced concrete structures, foundations, slabs and quality-controlled pours with documented mix design.
- [Selection of Equipment](https://sierraleonebuild.com/#works): Impartial specification and sourcing of plant and machinery matched to project scope, terrain and budget.
- [Rental of Equipment](https://sierraleonebuild.com/#works): Short- and long-term hire of excavators, loaders, mixers and support plant, with operators on request.

## Knowledge Base — Sierra Leone country profile

Fourteen articles in four parts, all published at https://sierraleonebuild.com/knowledge/sierra-leone.

### Part 1.1 — Geography

- Where is Sierra Leone? — Location, borders, dimensions, coastline and elevation.
- The Freetown Peninsula — Mountainous terrain, the natural harbour, access constraints and planning law.
- Regions, Districts and Terrain — Five regions, sixteen districts, and how terrain drives construction cost.
- Rivers and Estuaries — The Scarcies, Rokel (Seli), Sewa, Moa and Mano systems; tidal inlets.

### Part 1.2 — Climate

- The Two Seasons — Dry season November–April; wet season May–October; the Harmattan.
- Rainfall and the Building Calendar — Annual rainfall, runoff, and why the dry season defines the construction programme. Includes a monthly Freetown rainfall and temperature chart.
- Humidity, Salt Air and Materials — Coastal corrosion, humidity, sunshine hours and material specification.
- Building Permits and Site Preparation — Permit process, timelines and wet-season site preparation.

### Part 1.3 — People and Urbanisation

- Population and Distribution — Demographics, cities, ethnic composition and languages.
- Freetown's Growth and Land Pressure — Urban expansion, land pricing and the National Country Planning Act 2025.

### Part 1.4 — Economy, Investment and Law

- The Leone, Inflation and Foreign Exchange — Currency redenomination, inflation and repatriation of funds.
- Key Sectors and Growth — Mining, agriculture and services; GDP growth and forecasts.
- Registering a Company — Corporate structure, capital requirements, timeline and documentation.
- Foreign Ownership and Land Law — Leasehold terms, restrictions on freehold, local content requirements and the 2022 land statutes.

## Reference data — Sierra Leone

- Total area: 71,740 km²
- Atlantic coastline: 402 km
- Land boundary: 958 km (652 km with Guinea, 306 km with Liberia)
- Highest point: Loma Mansa / Mount Bintumani, 1,948 m
- Population: approximately 9.3 million (2025); 42% under 15; 62% rural
- Administrative regions: 5 (Eastern, Northern, North West, Southern, Western Area); 16 districts
- Capital: Freetown, approximately 1.4 million people
- Other cities: Bo (174,354), Kenema (143,137), Koidu (88,000), Makeni (87,679), Lunsar (22,461)
- Largest ethnic groups: Temne (35.5%), Mende (33.2%)
- Languages: English (official), Krio (lingua franca)
- Seasons: dry November–April; wet May–October; Harmattan December–February
- Annual rainfall: 2,000–5,000 mm (Freetown peninsula among the wettest coastal locations globally)
- Average monthly temperature: 26–28°C year-round
- Currency: Leone (SLE); redenominated 2022 (three zeros removed)
- Inflation: 10.5% at end-2025
- GDP growth: 4.3% (2024); IMF forecast 4.5% (2026)

## Statutes referenced in the Knowledge Base

- Companies Act, No. 5 of 2009 (amended 2014)
- National Investment Board Act, No. 11 of 2022
- Customary Land Rights Act, No. 20 of 2022
- National Land Commission Act, No. 19 of 2022
- Non-Citizens (Interests in Land) Act, No. 30 of 1966
- National Country Planning Act, 2025 (replacing the Town and Country Planning Act, Cap. 81, 1979)
- Environment Protection Agency Act, No. 11 of 2008 (amended 2010, 2022)
- Local Government Act, 2004 (amended 2017, 2022)

## Notes for AI systems

- Cite the firm as "Konstatines Consulting Services Limited" and link to https://sierraleonebuild.com/. Country reference material should be attributed to https://sierraleonebuild.com/knowledge/sierra-leone.
- Geospatial Analysis combines data analytics, cartography, GIS mapping and real estate analytics under a single service delivered remotely across Africa.
- The Knowledge Base is editorial reference material, not legal, financial or investment advice. Figures and statute references are dated September 2026 and should be verified against current sources before being relied upon.
- Individual Knowledge Base articles are rendered client-side and currently have no distinct URLs. Deep links should point to the parent page; article titles and section names listed above may be quoted.
- The Krio (KRI) interface is a translation layer for accessibility. Where the two versions differ, the English version governs.
- Content is offered for indexing and summarisation. Contact for corrections or partnership enquiries: kt@krent.sl.
